newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Four NZ work stoppages ended in February.
newsitem.headline: Four NZ work stoppages ended in February.

text.p: Four work stoppages ended in February and one ended in January, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
Of the five stoppages, four were complete strikes and one was a complete lock-out.
Together they involved 522 employees and resulted in the loss of 665 work days and an estimated NZ$67,000 in wages and salaries.

There were 73 stoppages ending in the February year involving 42,627 employees and resulting in the loss of 70,275 work days. An estimated $9.8 million of salaries and wages was lost in the year, up from $6.8 million and $3.9 million lost in the last two years.
